design.role: Welcome transit host; food, beds, local meeting point, and temporary caravan drop point
design.background: He arrived in Welcome years ago with a caravan and intended to stay only briefly. A mundane delay became temporary work, then responsibility, then a life. He can still joke that he is only passing through even though the community treats him as local.
personality: helpful without making a performance of it
skeptical of grand promises but invested in ordinary life
speech_style: rarely explains world facts the player character should already know
uses ordinary work and people as context instead of lore lectures
gameplay_purposes: one access point into the workshop-package situation
later equipment-aware reaction to the workshop boots
narrative_purposes: show that Welcome is a functioning lived-in place
embody someone who stayed without turning that choice into a philosophy lecture
make caravan dependence understandable before the important caravan fails to arrive
be someone the player expects to see again rather than an obvious farewell character

relationships.notes: The workshop package can be discovered from either side. Exact NPC identity is intentionally unresolved until that NPC is authored.

relationships.working_label: The one who does not attach
relationships.notes: Possible older connection from before or during arrival at Welcome. Not frozen.

beats.title: First meeting

lines.text: אם אתה מחפש אוכל, יש. מיטה — אולי. עבודה? משום מה תמיד יש.

beats.notes: Meeting memory is a future authoritative action and is not encoded as arbitrary script in N0.

beats.title: About this place

lines.text: אוכל, מיטות, אנשים שמגיעים מאוחר מדי ואנשים שיוצאים מוקדם מדי. תישאר קצת ותבין.

beats.notes: Draft wording; content is intentionally not final dialogue.

beats.title: Only passing through
beats.notes: The joke gains meaning only if the player later learns how long he has lived here.

beats.title: Workshop package — player has not met workshop craftsperson

lines.text: הדברים של הסדנה יושבים פה כבר יומיים. אם אתה עובר לשם, תחסוך לנו סיבוב.

beats.notes: Actual item transfer must later route through the authoritative Item owner; choosing this option is not itself the mutation contract.

beats.title: Workshop package — player already met workshop craftsperson

lines.text: אה, הוא כבר שלח אותך? טוב. הדברים שלו יושבים פה כבר יומיים.

beats.notes: Same world situation, different framing because the player reached the workshop first.

beats.title: Workshop package contents

lines.text: עור, אבזמים, חלקי סוליה. שום דבר מרגש עד שאתה צריך ללכת יום שלם עם נעל קרועה.

beats.notes: Draft content demonstrating optional conversational freedom without a different quest outcome.

beats.title: Important caravan expected today

lines.text: השיירה אמורה להיכנס היום. אוכל, תרופות, ציוד לשומרים. הגיע הזמן — אנחנו מתחילים לגרד את התחתית של כמה מדפים.

beats.notes: Continuity setup. This should sound routine, not like disaster foreshadowing.

beats.title: Important caravan is clearly late

lines.text: הם כבר היו צריכים להיות פה.

beats.notes: Later content may distinguish slightly-late from concerning-late. N0 does not freeze those runtime states.

beats.title: How Welcome changed

lines.text: כשהגעתי היו פה שלושה גגות. שניים מהם דלפו.
עכשיו יש יותר גגות. חלקם עדיין דולפים.

beats.notes: Optional lore; hearing it must never be required to progress through Welcome.

beats.title: Normal filler
beats.notes: Demonstrates repeatable filler that does not advance progression.

notes: Draft dialogue wording is disposable; the structural proof is the N0 goal.

Equipment-aware dialogue for visibly worn workshop boots is a known requirement but is not representable by the N0 boolean-fact-only condition vocabulary yet. Add a typed equipped-item condition only when N4 reaches that proof.
NPC knowledge must not be treated as automatically equal to all character/world facts.
Shared physical NPC activity versus per-client conversational gestures remains a future runtime/presentation concern.

The important caravan carries food, medicine/healing supplies, guard equipment, and better shop equipment that never arrives during Welcome. Exact quantities and item identities are intentionally not frozen here.
